newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi says A8 sales surging in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Audi says A8 sales surging in Germany.

text.p: Audi AG , the luxury carmaker unit of Volkswagen AG, said on Tuesday sales of its top-model A8 sedan surged in the first half of the year as production rose 49 percent to 7,177 vehicles.

Audi said sales in Germany rose 13 percent to about 3,800 vehicles during the period from January to June and that its market share of the domestic luxury segment rose to about 22 percent from 17.5 percent in the year-ago period.
Another 3,451 of the A8 vehicles were shipped abroad, an increase of 85.1 percent over the 1996 period.
